hangzhou-16.bio: Hangzhou museum of Chinese silk, textiles and the Silk Road, with galleries on silkworm rearing and weaving.

sources.cost: https://ct.zj.gov.cn/art/2019/8/5/art_1671969_36385240.html (free since 2004 per provincial culture dept page)

hangzhou-16.notes: Free entry per Zhejiang provincial page and search summaries; whether advance reservation is required is unverified (site has a 参观及预约 page, not read).

hangzhou-34.bio: Chan Buddhist temple in the hills of Yuhang, known for its tea-feast tradition and a five-gate entrance hall.
hangzhou-34.ticket_note: No official site found; temple/WeChat only, unverified
hangzhou-34.notes: 30 CNY is from a Ctrip user review only; shuttle from visitor centre is free, holiday parking ~20 CNY (not counted). Verify.

huzhou-9.bio: Qing-era merchant garden in Nanxun ancient town, built around a large lotus pond with a red-brick Western house.
huzhou-9.ticket_note: No official site found for the garden; Nanxun scenic area site not verified
huzhou-9.notes: 25 CNY from Ctrip 'from' price (weak); a joint ticket with Jiaye Library exists at the same starting price; Nanxun town itself is free to enter.

ningbo-1.bio: Ming-dynasty private library and garden in Ningbo, with a pond, rockeries and the book tower at its centre.
ningbo-1.ticketUrl_note: Page title 天一阁博物院 loaded, body is only a close button (script-rendered); confirm in a browser
ningbo-1.notes: 30 CNY adult per Ctrip and a 2022 note; some visitors mention reservations required, unverified. Wikipedia title is 'Tianyi Ge'.

longyou-caves.bio: Group of 24 man-made sandstone caverns near Longyou, cut into a hill at least 2,000 years ago by unknown hands.
longyou-caves.notes: Price weak and inconsistent (Ctrip 85, Qunar 65); verify. Age: clay in silt dated 206BC-23AD, so 'at least 2,000 years' is a conservative reading.

tiantai-mountain.bio: Sacred Tiantai Buddhist mountain, with Guoqing Temple, Shiliang waterfall and Huading peak at 1,138 m.
tiantai-mountain.notes: Not one gate: Huading Forest Park 50 CNY, Shiliang 60, Great Waterfall 100, Qiongtai 65 (Ctrip/Maigoo, weak); Guoqing Temple is free. 50 is Huading's. Pin is the mountain; sub-site prices unverified.
